ExtraBar 1.2.3 – Power at Your Fingertips! ⌨️🚀

✨ What's New

  • Keyboard Shortcut Actions: A brand-new action type that sends keyboard shortcuts to your apps! Configure any key + modifier combination and fire it with a single click – perfect for automating repetitive tasks!
  • Move & Copy Items Between Presets: Batch move or copy items between presets and folders! Multi-select, Select All, and context menu support make reorganizing your setup a breeze!
  • Global Hotkey for Bookmark Manager: Open Shiori Bookmark Manager instantly with Shift+Cmd+B – fully customizable in Settings!
  • Auto-Save Indicator: A subtle inline saving/saved status replaces manual Save buttons on auto-saving screens – cleaner and more intuitive!
  • Clickable List Rows: Click anywhere on a preset, app, or widget row to open its settings – no more hunting for the cog icon!

🎨 UI & Experience Improvements

  • Folder Widget Settings Redesign: Revamped layout with inlined header fields and a dedicated item selection screen – organizing your folders has never felt better!
  • Streamlined Widget Editors: A new unified component brings consistent name, icon, and color fields across all widget editors!
  • Inline Action Parameters: Action parameters now display inline instead of in a separate popup – fewer clicks, faster setup!
  • Bookmark Widget Polish: Improved anchoring, rounded chrome, and better popover positioning for a refined bookmark experience!
  • Responsive Widget Editor: Flexible sizing adapts beautifully to different screen sizes!
  • Keyboard Navigation in Pickers: Arrow key navigation with visual highlighting in tag and folder pickers – navigate effortlessly!

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • Preset List Sync: Fixed an issue where the preset item list didn't update after removing an app!
  • Bookmark Popover Anchor: Popover now anchors correctly in menu bar mode!
  • Clearer Sync Status: Renamed status label from "Fresh" to "Sync" for better clarity!

🚀 What's Next?

We're continuing to refine and expand ExtraBar with more powerful automation features and quality-of-life improvements based on your feedback!

Thank you for being part of the ExtraBar community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make – keep it coming! 💙
